_instructions: Copy this file once per labelled PDF (e.g. eval/gold/<pdf-name>.json). Set source_file to the PDF file name in data/pdfs/. Replace every FILL_IN with the value you read in the document: numbers for money and ratios (14500000, 1.45), text for the rest. Use null when the document genuinely does not state the field. Leave FILL_IN for anything you have not checked yet; it is skipped, not scored. Keep this template unchanged.
